test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As per Census 2011, what is the percentage of rural population in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**68.8%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to Census 2011, 68.8% of India’s population resides in rural areas.
 
• This translates to approximately 833 million people.
 
• The rural population percentage is crucial for planning rural development policies.
 
• Rural areas often face challenges like limited access to healthcare and education.
